audit.title: JOBSAGE Sponsor Employer Direct ATS Coverage Audit

sampling.design: For each of 12 sectors, up to five employers without an existing ATS mapping but with a stored website/careers URL, plus up to five with neither URL; all 19 existing ATS mappings included as a certainty sample.
sampling.selection: Deterministic MD5 ordering of normalized organisation keys within each sector/stratum.
sampling.limitations: Five non-mapped employers per sector per URL stratum is suitable for a feasibility screen, not a stable national vacancy extrapolation.

method.nameGuessing: Suffix-stripped compact company/trading-name slug, then one hyphenated alternate if the first slug returned no non-empty feed.
method.roleEligibilityFiltering: Not applied; counts are raw public ATS postings and are not filtered for UK location, visa sponsorship, or employer sponsorship validity.
method.urlRedaction: Output URLs omit userinfo, query strings, and fragments.

confidenceRules.verified: Saved mapping status was already verified, or stored evidence URL shared the employer website host.
confidenceRules.probable: Non-empty feed on a unique name/trading-name-derived board slug.
confidenceRules.uncertain: Non-empty feed found through a stored mapping whose board ownership was not established by verified status or a strong unique name match.
confidenceRules.note: Probable matches are not production-safe until official employer-site ownership is confirmed.

costEstimate.projectionReason: Do not extrapolate from five employers per sector/URL stratum: one high-volume board match in the Unclassified stratum would dominate naive weighting. Expand the sample before making a population-level estimate.

recommendation.directLookupWorthDoing: Yes as a cheap first pass for saved board IDs and exact brand slugs; no as a standalone replacement for website/careers enrichment.
